name: Hornero Containers
description: A read-only roster of your Podman and Docker containers: state, image, uptime and published ports. Never starts, stops or pulls anything. Says so plainly when no runtime answers.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Initial release: read-only Podman/Docker container roster with state, image, status and published ports, as a dashboard card and a desktop widget.

runtime.description: Auto tries Podman first and falls back to Docker; both merges the two lists.

showStopped.description: List stopped and exited containers after the running ones.

maxRows.description: Most containers to list; running ones come first.

refreshSeconds.description: Seconds between runtime queries. Querying pauses in the Gaming experience.
